help.faq1_q: How do I complete KYC verification?
help.faq1_a: To complete KYC verification, go to your Profile, click on 'KYC Verification', and submit your government-issued ID along with a selfie. Our team typically reviews and approves submissions within 24-48 hours.
help.faq2_a: Navigate to the Wallet section, select 'Deposit', choose your cryptocurrency, and copy the deposit address or scan the QR code. Always double-check the network before sending.
help.faq3_q: How do I withdraw my funds?
help.faq3_a: Go to Wallet > Withdraw, select the cryptocurrency, enter the withdrawal address and amount. Withdrawals are processed within 24 hours.
help.faq4_q: How does the referral program work?
help.faq4_a: Share your unique referral link with friends. When they sign up and trade, you earn commission on their trading fees. Track your referrals and earnings in the Referrals section.
help.faq5_a: Copy Trading allows you to automatically replicate trades from experienced traders. Browse top traders, review their performance, and allocate funds to copy their strategies.
help.faq6_a: Click on any support topic below to instantly connect with our support team on Telegram. Our team is available 24/7.
help.faq7_a: Withdrawals may be pending due to security checks, incomplete KYC, or network congestion. Most withdrawals are processed within 24 hours.
help.faq8_q: How long does KYC verification take?
help.faq8_a: KYC verification typically takes 24-48 hours. You'll receive an email notification once your verification is approved.
help.faq9_q: How do I change my account settings?
help.faq9_a: Go to Profile > Settings to update your account preferences. You can change your email, password, notification preferences, and security settings.
help.faq10_q: How do I enable or disable notifications?
help.faq10_a: Navigate to Settings > Notifications to customize your notification preferences. You can toggle notifications for trades, deposits, withdrawals, and more.
help.faq11_q: How do I change my password?
help.faq11_a: Go to Profile > Settings > Security, then select 'Change Password'. Enter your current password, then your new password twice to confirm.
help.faq12_q: Can I change my email address?
help.faq12_a: Yes, go to Settings > Account Information and click 'Change Email'. Enter your new email address and verify it through the confirmation link.
